# brand-canon/ — synced mirror (do not edit here)

This folder is a **version-controlled mirror** of the ARCHV brand-system source
files, whose working copies live in `~/Claude/fifa.archv/` and are read directly
by the content routines (archv-match-of-the-day, match-covers, archv-ai-carousel,
etc.).

**These copies are a snapshot for versioning/reference only.** No routine reads
from this folder. The authoritative, routine-read files remain at their original
`~/Claude/fifa.archv/` paths. If you change a brand file, change the original and
re-sync this mirror — do not edit files here expecting routines to pick them up.

Mirrored 2026-08-25 from these source paths (relative to ~/Claude/fifa.archv/):

- brand-colors.json
- BRAND-COLORS.md
- brand-voice-guidelines.md
- brand-voice-CHEATSHEET.md
- DESIGN-PLAYBOOK.md
- CANONICAL-CONTEXT.md
- PREMATCH-CAROUSEL.md
- STATIC-IMAGE-REEL-SPEC.md
- REEL-ARC.md
- REEL-CARD-BANK.md
- brand/README.md
- brand/archv-wordmark-pair1.svg
- archv-ai-carousel/tokens.json
